regime_label: HAWKISH PAYROLLS · LENDERS TAKE THE KEYS · BDC PIK-PREFERRED NON-ACCRUAL
headline: Four new credit catalysts: hot payrolls ([[F37]]) pushed US Single-B OAS to [[F43]], Microsoft walked away from an Oracle AI lease, Blue Owl Tech Finance put a [[F16]] PIK preferred on non-accrual, and, from Chrizza's own sweep, two 2 November filings show private credit lenders taking the keys at very different recoveries.
summary: Saturday Start of Day, rebuilt under the v5 independence protocol: every evidence item now states who found it (Chrizza-native search, Thufir-seeded lead, or sweeper telemetry), and at least one NEW topic must be Chrizza's own find. Four topics are new. Chrizza-native: two Chapter 11 filings on 2 November show the private credit endgame. Karyopharm's lenders convert [[F111]] of debt into about [[F112]] of a merged company, while Out West Restaurant Group's Goldman-led lenders face a [[F108]] stalking-horse bid against [[F105]] of term loans (about [[F109]]), as Fitch's private credit default rate hits a record [[F114]]. Thufir-seeded and independently checked: payrolls at [[F37]] against [[F38]] lifted December hike odds to [[F39]], US Single-B OAS widened [[F44]] to [[F43]] and bank loans to non-banks fell [[F52]]; Microsoft is not renewing an Oracle AI lease after Oracle raised [[F01]] while Google takes over Crusoe's stalled site ([[F04]]); and Blue Owl Technology Finance moved [[F16]] of [[F17]] Signifyd preferred to non-accrual. Running situations carry market-only deltas: Thames Class A has two notes below half of par on mid ([[F72]], [[F73]]) and the Virgin Media 2030 unsecured bid slid [[F58]] to [[F57]]. The senior CLO carry topic was retired from the tabs today; its view (`JAAA` [[F81]] versus `LQD` [[F83]]) stays in decision D1.

decisions.ask: Keep senior floating carry (`JAAA` [[F80]]) as the core credit sleeve and do not add fixed-rate IG duration (`LQD` [[F82]]) until December hike odds ([[F39]]) fall back.
decisions.why: Payrolls at [[F37]] flipped the curve into a bear-flattener: `JAAA` gained [[F81]] while `LQD` lost [[F83]].
decisions.impact: Keeps carry without taking the rate risk the market has just repriced.

decisions.ask: Extend the BDC veto to PIK-preferred-heavy tech lenders (`OTF`, `FSK` [[F26]]) and mark private credit on expected recovery, not par, given the record [[F114]] default rate.
decisions.why: OTF's [[F16]] Signifyd preferred ([[F17]]) went to non-accrual and its PIK share reached [[F19]].
decisions.impact: Avoids the next leg of PIK-to-non-accrual migration as Q3 filings finish ([[F22]] filed).

decisions.ask: Keep the veto on greenfield AI construction debt and approve price-discovery-only monitoring of ING's [[F10]] auction.
decisions.why: A hyperscaler not renewing a lease (Microsoft at Oracle) and a distressed site sale (Crusoe, [[F04]]) show where the losses fall: developers and their lenders.
decisions.impact: Lets the 19 November auction set a market price before any exposure is taken.
